record.description: The SaaS benchmark report highlights that buyers in our category are now shortlisting only three vendors during the first week of their evaluation process and making a decision by the third week. Additionally, there is an observed distrust towards ROI claims made by vendors themselves.

segmentation_implications.strategy: offer concise, compelling information to streamline their decision-making process
emphasize third-party validation of ROI claims

messaging_advice.shortlisting_phase: Highlight the unique value proposition and competitive edge in a clear, digestible manner.
messaging_advice.decision_making_phase: Provide robust evidence from independent sources to support ROI claims.
